definition: Emotional expression is the characteristic bodily change that happens along with an emotion. When these changes chiefly involve the face, they are called facial expression; historically, psychologists debated whether the feeling comes first and causes the bodily expression, or whether the bodily changes are what give rise to the felt emotion.
